releaseNotes.en: Preview checklist: LepTraits and the NHM HOSTS archive supply exact-match wingspan, habitat-affinity, phenology or host-plant facts for part of the list. Visual identification traits remain unverified and regional phenology coverage is sparse; absent fields mean no verified species-level source. Plates with unrecorded reference rights remain archetypes.

sources: Spidex compilation from cached Indochina butterfly list and iNaturalist/GBIF observations
Source lineage and species-level field accounts require expert review

HOSTS Lepidopteran hostplants archive (Natural History Museum 2023; CC0)
